title: IBC Reports Strong Earnings for the First Six Months of 2026
summary: LAREDO, Texas, August 06, 2026--International Bancshares Corporation (NASDAQ:IBOC), today reported net income for the six months ended June 30, 2026 of $198.0 million.

title: International Bancshares Corporation Announces Cash Dividend
summary: LAREDO, Texas, August 03, 2026--International Bancshares Corporation announced today $0.73 per share cash dividend for shareholders of record of common stock.
